description:
An ostracised fisherwoman (Olivia Colman) commissions the village basketmaker (Peter Dinklage) to weave her the perfect husband out of wicker. When her new husband (Alexander Skarsgård) turns out more spectacular than she ever imagined, his soulful spirit sparks a wave of jealousy and fascination that threatens to unravel the entire village. An audacious comedic fable about love, marriage, and the absurd expectations of society, straight from Sundance 2026.

Starring: Olivia Colman, Alexander Skarsgård, Peter Dinklage, Elizabeth Debicki, Richard E. Grant
Directed by: Eleanor Wilson & Alex Huston Fischer
In theaters October 23, 2026 (UK & Ireland October 30)
